passage:
From Farm Stand to Supermarket Shelf

When Marguerite Olawale began selling homemade fruit preserves at a weekend farmers' market eight years ago, she had no plans to start a company. — [1] — Today, her brand, Orchard Lane, is stocked in more than 300 grocery stores across four states.

The turning point came in 2021, when a buyer for a regional supermarket chain tasted her apricot jam at the market and asked whether she could supply 50 stores. — [2] — "I said yes before I had any idea how I would do it," Ms. Olawale recalled with a laugh.

Meeting that first order meant moving production from her home kitchen to a rented commercial kitchen and hiring her first three employees. It also meant learning about food safety certification, labeling regulations, and shipping logistics—subjects she admits she knew almost nothing about. — [3] —

Despite its rapid growth, Orchard Lane still buys most of its fruit from family farms within 100 miles of its facility. Ms. Olawale says this is not only a matter of principle but also a practical choice. — [4] — "Fruit that hasn't traveled far simply tastes better, and our customers notice the difference."
question: What is the article mainly about?
choices: The opening of a new farmers' market
Changes to food safety regulations
A supermarket chain's new store design
The growth of a small food business
answer: The growth of a small food business
explanation: 週末の市場から始まり300店舗で扱われるようになったジャムの会社の成長を描いている。

To: All Clinic Staff
From: Dr. Simone Achterberg
Date: January 6
Subject: Patient reminder system

Dear team,

As many of you know, missed appointments have become a growing problem for our clinic. Last quarter, about one in eight patients did not show up for a scheduled visit, which led to long waiting lists and wasted staff time.

To address this, we will begin using an automated reminder service on February 1. Patients will receive a text message three days before their appointment and again on the morning of the visit. They will be able to confirm or cancel by replying to the message, and any canceled slots will automatically be offered to patients on the waiting list.

Patients who prefer not to receive text messages may choose to receive an automated phone call instead. Reception staff should ask patients about their preference when they check in during January.

A representative from the service provider will give a short demonstration at our staff meeting next Wednesday. I hope you will all be able to attend.

Simone
question: What problem does Dr. Achterberg mention?
choices: The clinic has too few receptionists.
Text messages have been sent to the wrong patients.
Patients have been missing appointments.
The waiting room is too crowded.
answer: Patients have been missing appointments.
explanation: 前四半期は患者の約8人に1人が予約に来なかったと述べている。

Room for up to 15 people

Room for up to 30 people, morning coffee break

Room for up to 50 people, morning and afternoon coffee breaks, buffet lunch

Guests staying at Altamira Suites receive 15 percent off any meeting package. Bookings must be made at least ten days in advance.

To: events@altamirasuites.example
From: Hyun-woo Kang <hkang@novaline-tech.example>
Date: August 4
Subject: Meeting room booking

Hello,

I would like to book a meeting room for a training day on August 20. We expect 24 participants, and we would like a coffee break in the morning. We will arrange our own lunch at a nearby restaurant.

Three of our trainers will be traveling from our head office and will stay at your hotel on the nights of August 19 and 20. Could you please reserve three single rooms for them as well?

Kind regards,
Hyun-woo Kang
Training Manager, Novaline Technologies

Review posted by H. Kang on August 23

We held a training day at Altamira Suites, and overall it went very well. The room was bright and comfortable, and the coffee break was generous. The staff were helpful, especially when our projector cable stopped working and a technician replaced it within minutes.

My only suggestion is to provide clearer signs. Several of our participants had trouble finding the meeting room, which is in a separate wing of the building, and a few arrived late. Still, I would happily book here again.
question: What problem occurred during the training day?
choices: The coffee break was too short.
A piece of equipment failed.
The room was too small.
The Wi-Fi was unavailable.
answer: A piece of equipment failed.
